limitations: Ten-second clip, no independently reviewed contact, shot or player labels. Isolated session, not the user live database.
extraction: ffmpeg -ss 60 -i proxy.mp4 -t 10 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p doubles-probe.mp4
measurements_note: Wall time includes upload, media preparation, model loading, processing, polling and post-run API reads. GPU memory is sampled and can miss peaks. Outputs and labels are unverified; three observed candidate episodes do not establish four-player coverage.
